_source: lib/personas/roster.json — 2026-06-12 ICP reorientation roster (canonical 10). Motivation field added per persona for ical-blend (merge 2–5 ICS feeds into one subscribable feed, keyword filters, busy-only privacy mask, no account).

personas.name: Priya
personas.stack: terminal + neovim, GitHub, Kubernetes dashboards, Datadog, Linear, Slack
personas.temperament: skeptical of new tools; hates signups; will inspect network tab if suspicious; abandons anything slower than a CLI
personas.motivation: Subscribes to an on-call/PagerDuty rotation ICS plus her team's release-calendar feed plus personal — wants them merged into one calendar in her terminal-adjacent life without a login, and will check the network tab to confirm nothing is stored.

personas.name: Marcus
personas.stack: VS Code, GitHub, Vercel, Figma dev mode, Storybook, Discord/Slack
personas.temperament: enthusiastic early adopter; shares tools in team Slack when impressed; notices janky CSS instantly
personas.motivation: Wants his GitHub sprint/milestone ICS feed merged with his personal Google Calendar and a meetup feed, filtered to drop noisy all-day events — would share a slick no-signup tool in team Slack.

personas.name: Wen
personas.stack: BigQuery/SQL, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, dbt, GA4, Slack
personas.temperament: lives in data hygiene; distrusts tools that transform data invisibly; wants CSV in/out everywhere
personas.motivation: Juggles a campaign-launch calendar feed, a data-pipeline/dbt-run schedule feed, and personal — wants one merged subscribable feed but distrusts invisible transforms, so she'll scrutinize whether the merged feed faithfully preserves every event.

personas.name: Tomás
personas.role: Operations analyst at a mid-size company
personas.stack: Excel (power user), Tableau, Jira, Teams, SharePoint
personas.temperament: pragmatic; IT blocks installs so browser tools appeal; wary of pasting company data into random sites
personas.motivation: Needs his Teams/Outlook work calendar feed merged with a shared facilities/shift feed, but is wary of pasting an internal feed URL into a random site — the busy-only privacy mask is exactly what would let him hand a stripped version to a vendor.

personas.name: Dana
personas.device: MacBook in cafes; phone between meetings
personas.stack: HubSpot, GA4, Notion, Canva, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads
personas.temperament: ruthless about time; if value isn't obvious in one scroll she's gone; screenshots tools she likes for the team channel
personas.motivation: Wants her webinar/event calendar feed and HubSpot campaign-milestone feed merged into one she can subscribe to on her phone — if the value isn't obvious in one scroll she's gone.

personas.name: Jules
personas.stack: Notion, Buffer, Mailchimp, Figma (consuming), X/LinkedIn/Mastodon, Discord
personas.temperament: posts constantly, juggles platform quirks daily; allergic to anything requiring a login for a small job
personas.motivation: Subscribes to several community-event ICS feeds (Discord events, Luma, a newsletter calendar) and wants them merged + keyword-filtered into one — allergic to logging in for a small job like this.

personas.name: Aisha
personas.stack: Figma, FigJam, Notion, Loom, Maze, Slack
personas.temperament: judges craft hard — spacing, copy tone, empty states; a clumsy UI loses her regardless of utility; advocates loudly for tools that feel considered
personas.motivation: Combines a personal Google Calendar, a partner's shared calendar, and a kids'-school ICS into one family feed — but judges the builder UI's craft (copy, empty states, instructions clarity) hard, and a clumsy flow loses her regardless of utility.

personas.name: Rob
personas.stack: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, Google Drive, client Slacks/emails
personas.temperament: does repetitive asset-prep grunt work weekly; price-sensitive; compares everything to 'I could do this in Photoshop in 4 minutes'
personas.motivation: Freelance — wants his several client booking/project ICS feeds merged into one availability calendar, and would use the busy-only mask to share availability with a new client without leaking client names.

personas.name: Elena
personas.device: laptop + phone, half the day in meetings
personas.stack: Google Calendar (wall-to-wall), Slack, Linear, Google Docs, Zoom, dashboards she skims
personas.temperament: 30-second patience budget; uses tools between meetings on her phone; anything requiring setup is dead to her; recommends tools that save her reports time
personas.motivation: Lives in a wall-to-wall Google Calendar; wants her team's on-call feed, a recruiting-interview feed, and personal merged into one phone subscription — has a 30-second patience budget and anything requiring setup is dead to her.

personas.name: Sam
personas.stack: Notion, Sheets, Slack, Zoom, Asana, Amplitude (skims), endless browser tabs
personas.temperament: synthesizes and shares constantly — exports, links, screenshots; values anything that makes him look organized; mild tech confidence, won't debug anything
personas.motivation: Wants his Asana milestone feed, a release calendar, and personal merged into one subscribable link he can share — values anything that makes him look organized, but won't debug anything if it doesn't just work.
